package contract

import "context"

//plystra:resource accounts.access/v1
type Resource interface {
	Get(context.Context, Request) (Row, error)
	Find(context.Context, Request) (*Row, error)
	List(context.Context, Request) ([]Row, error)
}

type Request struct {
	Key    int64
	Text   string
	Active bool
	Token  []byte
	Score  float64
}

type Row struct {
	Key            int64
	Text           string
	Active         bool
	Token          []byte
	Score          float64
	OptionalKey    *int64
	OptionalText   *string
	OptionalActive *bool
	OptionalToken  *[]byte
	OptionalScore  *float64
}
